description: This Java class 'DisplayUtils' provides utility methods for an Android application, including converting categories to navigation items, detecting soft keyboard visibility, starting link intents, and showing snack bar messages.

classes.name: DisplayUtils
classes.description: A utility class for various display-related functions in an Android app, including category conversion, keyboard detection, intent handling, and snack bar messaging.

methods.name: convertToCategoryNavigationItem
methods.description: Converts a collection of CategoryWithNotesCount objects into a list of CategoryNavigationItems for navigation purposes.

methods.name: convertToCategoryNavigationItem
methods.description: Converts a single CategoryWithNotesCount object into a CategoryNavigationItem, determining the appropriate icon based on category name.

methods.name: getEnglishResources
methods.description: Creates a Resources object with locale set to English for comparison purposes.

methods.name: isSoftKeyboardVisible
methods.description: Detects if the soft keyboard is visible, using different methods depending on Android API level.

methods.name: startLinkIntent
methods.description: Overloaded methods to start a link intent from a string resource, URL string, or Uri.

methods.name: startIntentIfAppAvailable
methods.description: Attempts to start an intent if an application is available to handle it; otherwise shows a snack message.

methods.name: showSnackMessage
methods.description: Displays a Snackbar message, either by resource ID or string, bound to activity content or a specific view.
